research.intro: Applied research at the intersection of NLP, clinical text and security: building models that are tested properly, not just trained.

current.title: Clinical Bias Detection in Discharge Summaries
current.desc: Note-level detection of clinician bias (explicit, implicit, none) in MIMIC-III v1.4 discharge summaries, using 9,000 human-labelled notes, patient-grouped splits and a frozen 1,500-note test set. Compares a lexicon baseline and TF-IDF with long-context clinical encoders (BioClinical ModernBERT, Clinical-Longformer, Clinical-BigBird) and QLoRA-fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B, with a keyword-masking test, paired bootstrap intervals and calibration analysis. Results will be shared after peer review.
